audit_scope: Focused comparison of tracked skill, package, notices, README, and changelog; not a repository-wide audit
curation_rules: Whenever user-facing copy names the product, editor, review session, or skill, use Monolayer; never adopt Lavish or Lavish Editor as the curated product name.

Preserve upstream technical and legal identifiers verbatim where compatibility or attribution requires them: the lavish-axi package and executable, LAVISH_AXI_* environment variables, .lavish-axi paths, protocol and storage keys, repository URLs, source titles, copyright, and license text.
Apply the branding adaptation to every adopted upstream change before advancing audited_revision, then verify affected skills, documentation, evals, examples, and interface metadata.

Add the Monolayer runtime branding layer from skills/monolayer/SKILL.md to every reviewed artifact: rewrite rendered chrome brand text and window titles to Monolayer at presentation time while preserving compatibility identifiers, protocol or storage keys, code samples, and third-party or legal notes.
